svg.title: APC Patchbay Assign walkthrough · current firmware
svg.desc: Source-reviewed quick card for the physical APC Key 25 mk2 gen122. Read current route and placement state. Open Arrange with Stop All Clips 51. For the source, press Assign 20, select a Scene row, browse with Track 3 or 4 only if needed until the indicator-only strip previews the desired input, then confirm with 07 when bright. Repeat Assign 20 for the destination Track column, browse only if needed, and confirm with 07. Exit Arrange with Stop All Clips and wait for the full Patch refresh. Do not press a candidate pad or send a note. Optional Learn 22 is a separate action: a distinct MIDI attack identifies a source and can pass through existing live routes. Exact live Assign gestures and visual results remain unverified. Direct tapping a lit candidate is a proposal, not installed behavior.
svg.text: Physical APC Key 25 mk2 · installed gen122 · button IDs are hexadecimal
The dated gen122 map is historical. Confirm the current source, destination and slots.
2 · PREVIEW, BROWSE IF NEEDED, CONFIRM SOURCE
Middle pads are indicators only. Browse Track 3 · 42 / Track 4 · 43 until blue matches, only if needed.
Press when bright to commit this source slot.
Browse Track 3 / 4 only if needed; middle candidate pads remain indicators.
Press when bright to commit the destination slot.
4 · EXIT AND WAIT FOR THE FULL PATCH REFRESH
No note is needed. Placement does not prove MIDI delivery.
A current sight check is read-only: no pad press and no MIDI.
Learn · 22 selects a Scene source. Its distinct MIDI attack identifies input and may pass through active routes.
Pad 06 previews Unassigned; browse with Track 3 / 4, then Confirm 07 to clear the selected slot.
